responsibility: Defines projection-goal solving for the next trait solver, dispatching `NormalizesTo` goals by projected item kind, applying the unconstrained-RHS normalization strategy, assembling and matching trait-associated projection candidates through the shared candidate framework, and handling built-in projection cases such as anon consts and special language items.
same_name_distinction: Among the `solve/*/mod.rs` files, this one is the `ProjectionPredicate`/`NormalizesTo` specialization layer. It differs from `assembly/mod.rs` by implementing `GoalKind` specifically for projections and from `eval_ctxt/mod.rs` and `solve/mod.rs` by handling associated type/const normalization cases, the unconstrained-RHS hack, and built-in projection forms like anon consts, opaques, and weak type aliases.
